Workflow

How It Works

From first enquiry to final delivery, here's what to expect when you work with our engineering and manufacturing team.

01

Enquiry

Share your project requirements, site conditions, and structural needs with our team.

02

Design & FEA Review

Our engineers design and validate the structure using Finite Element Analysis for your specific load and site conditions.

03

Manufacturing

Approved designs move to in-house fabrication — cutting, forming, and hot-dip galvanizing.

04

Quality Testing

Every structure is tested for load and durability before it leaves our facility.

05

Delivery

Completed structures are dispatched and delivered to your project site.
